Requirement: The system shall show a splash screen and route users to /auth or /home based on Supabase session state.
Users shall be able to sign up, sign in, sign out, request password reset, and update password/profile.
Authenticated users shall access a role-aware home shell with route-based navigation.
Elder Studio shall support recording/importing audio, metadata tagging, local draft save, and cloud sync preparation.
The system shall provide offline-first sync states for recordings (local_only, syncing, synced, sync_failed).
Sound Archive shall list recordings, play audio, show sync state, paginate, and allow sync/retry actions.
The review workflow shall allow transcription retry and approval flow, including optional word promotion.
Translation shall support semai, ms, and en via edge function ai-translate with auth token refresh handling.
AI Helper shall support guided actions (start_session, continue_session, end_session, translate_inline) with session state persistence.
Language Garden shall provide quiz, vocab, and wordle loops with level-up progression flow.
Story module shall support browse, search, detail, and read routes.
Profile module shall support edit/settings subroutes and redirect unauthenticated users to /auth.
Edge-function calls requiring identity shall use bearer token validation and refresh logic.
Offline operations shall preserve recording data and pending sync queue across sessions.
Core local experience shall remain usable when offline (archive visibility, local audio handling, queued sync).
User interactions shall provide responsive feedback via micro-interactions and haptics on key actions.
The UI shall communicate loading, success, warning, and error states clearly (spinners, toasts, messages).
Controls should maintain baseline accessibility through labels and semantic input/button usage.
The codebase shall remain TypeScript-strict and modular for maintainability.
Core business logic should be unit-testable and covered by existing tests.
App behavior should work across web and Capacitor targets without platform-dependent failure.
AI provider assignments shall follow documentation correction: Coqui for TTS and Nano Banana for image generation only.
